doc.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010

title: A shy kid in Memphis who became outgoing in Chicago
summary: Mabern says he was very quiet and shy in Memphis and grew more outgoing after moving to Chicago.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I’m wondering if you were an outgoing kid?

You know strangely enough I was very shy. Believe it or not I was very quiet, very shy. But as I got a little older I got a little more, how do you put it, outgoing and aggressive in my manner so to speak, when I moved to Chicago. But during the time I was in Memphis, Tennessee I was really a quiet, shy kid you know.
